values.note: RV/electric sites $37 a night; tent-only sites $27. An extra tent is $27 a night (two units a site), free when it holds the reservation holder's children 17 and under. Card fees of 3% or more are added by the processor.

note: McLeod County park on the southeast corner of Lake Marion, about 6 miles south of Hutchinson off Highway 15. RV sites are back-in, with water shared between sites; generators are not allowed. --Claude
summary: County pages + 2026 map/brochure/policies read: 39 sites (27 RV at 50 A with shared water, back-in only; 12 tent-only), $37 RV / $27 tent for 2026, 14-night max, showers + free dump for campers, 2027 season Apr 30-Oct 17, booked online via PerfectMind (account required, no login done). Real public county campground. Not waterfront kept. Phone and pin flagged.
